chunks: Muhammad ibn 'Ali ibn Mahbub narrated from 'Ali ibn al-Sindi, from Muhammad ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Jamil ibn Darraj, from Zurarah and Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:
Jumu'ah becomes obligatory upon one who is within two farsakhs of it.

key_terms.الْجُمُعَةُ: the Jumu'ah prayer held on Friday
key_terms.عَلَى: upon; indicating the person legally addressed by the ruling
key_terms.فَرْسَخَيْنِ: two farsakhs; a measure of distance determining applicability of the ruling
key_terms.مِنْهَا: from it; from the place where Jumu'ah is held

ai.seo_question: Upon whom is Jumu'ah prayer obligatory in terms of distance?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the obligation of Jumu'ah prayer based on distance. It indicates that the duty applies to those who are within two farsakhs of the place where Jumu'ah is established.
